output.explanation: The only document with substantive text addressing algorithmic rent setting in Los Angeles is D039, which is a motion from September 3, 2024 instructing the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on ownership and management entities. This is a pending motion requesting analysis/reporting, not an enacted rule. The other guidance documents (D040-D043) address the Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance and RSO rent increase calculations through traditional means, not algorithmic pricing. The state-level rules CA-ALG-01 and CA-ALG-02 apply to common pricing algorithms and Cartwright Act pleading standards but do not create a specific Los Angeles city-level rule on algorithmic rent setting. No adopted ordinance or regulation prohibiting or regulating algorithmic rent setting at the city level is found in the provided sources.
